test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence with its ANTONYM.

The teacher filled the students' minds with __pessimistic__ thoughts about their futures.
solution:
The correct answer is: Bright.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pessimistic"** means having a negative outlook; expecting the worst to happen. (निराशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **pessimistic **about the outcome of the project.
 
 
 
• **"Bright"** refers to having a positive outlook; full of hope and promise. (उज्ज्वल)
 
 
• **Example: **The future looked **bright **for the young entrepreneur.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'pessimistic'** is **'bright'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Discouraging **(हतोत्साहित करने वाला): Causing someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** The negative feedback was quite **discouraging**.
 
 
 
• **Cynical **(निंदक): Believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a **cynical **attitude towards politics.
 
 
 
• **Desperate** (निराशाजनक): Feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with.
 
 
• **Example:** He made a **desperate **attempt to save the company.
